dialogue.conversations.gulp.hard/1: I remember. I thought I wasn't getting out of there, %1$s. I'm still a little shaken.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.hard/2: You scared me half to death in there. Please don't ever do that again.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.hard/3: Don't remind me. I could feel the walls closing in. I'm just glad I'm out.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.soft/1: Oh, that! It was warm and... honestly kind of cozy. Just ask first next time, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.soft/2: I remember. It felt safe in there, strangely. I trust you, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.soft/3: Funny thing to bring up, but I didn't hate it. Just don't make a habit of it.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.witness/1: I saw what happened to that poor villager. I won't forget it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.witness/2: Everyone in the village still talks about it. It was horrible.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.witness/3: I remember. I still can't look at you quite the same way.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.saw/1: I saw you carrying someone around. It looked... odd.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.saw/2: I remember seeing you gulp someone down. I hope they were okay.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.none/1: Remember what? I don't know what you're talking about.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.none/2: Stomach? I think you've got the wrong villager, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.none/3: Um... no? Is this some kind of joke?
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw: Did you see me swallow anyone?
dialogue.gulp.talk/1: Oh? Alright, what do you want to know?
dialogue.gulp.talk/2: Hm, that again? Go ahead, ask.
dialogue.gulp.talk/3: Sure. Ask me anything about it.
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.digest/1: I saw it, %1$s. I'll never forget what happened to that poor villager.
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.digest/2: Yes. I saw you do it. Please don't make me talk about it.
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.digest/3: I saw. I still can't get it out of my head.
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.swallow/1: I saw you gulp someone down. They seemed okay, but it was a strange sight.
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.swallow/2: Yes, I saw. I hope whoever it was is alright.
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.swallow/3: I did. It looked... uncomfortable, honestly.
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.none/1: No? I haven't seen you swallow anyone, %1$s. Why, who was it?
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.none/2: I don't think so. What are you talking about?
dialogue.gulp.talk.saw.none/3: Not that I remember. Should I have?
dialogue.gulp.talk.invited.yes/1: Being carried was a lot of fun, %1$s! Ask me again any time.
dialogue.gulp.talk.invited.yes/2: It was cozy in there, and I trusted you the whole time. Let's do it again sometime.
dialogue.gulp.talk.invited.yes/3: Yes! Thanks for taking care of me, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.talk.invited.none/1: Carried? I don't think I've done that with you, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.talk.invited.none/2: Hm, no. Why, were you thinking of asking?
dialogue.gulp.talk.invited.none/3: I don't know what you mean. Maybe if we get to know each other better.
